title: Kenyan Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Kenya, made with tender beef and a blend of aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: kenyan spices
ingredients.notes: a blend of turmeric, coriander, and cumin

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced red chili peppers and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the beef broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1.5 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Stir in the kenyan spices and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
